context_slide.title: Modernizing DMN compliance reviews for Drools
context_slide.body_copy_01:
Manual and noisy compliance tracking:
  Known gaps on master (9 baseline failures) led to noise
  PR failures were difficult to isolate from master gaps
  Slow integration cycle due to manual verification
context_slide.body_copy_02:
Automated and isolated PR evaluations:
  Fully automates upstream PR compatibility checks
  Isolates master failures from net-new regressions
  Provides reviewers with noise-free health reports

pillars_grid.title: The four pillars of our automation pipeline
pillars_grid.body_copy_01: Runs weekly or on-demand. Merges latest upstream TCK master to keep test definitions in sync.
pillars_grid.body_copy_02: Caches maven dependencies and only compiles DMN modules. caches baseline results to skip runs.
pillars_grid.body_copy_03: Spins up temporary workspaces. clones, merges, and tests each PR against drools. flags conflicts.
pillars_grid.body_copy_04: Aggregates test run metadata and renders clean HTML. Deploys using a robust push-with-retry rebase.

features_wins.title: Delivering highly actionable reviews for developers
features_wins.body_copy_01:
Isolating regressions from baseline gaps:
  Separates pre-existing gaps from new PR bugs
  Color-coded PR rows (green/yellow/red) for safety
  Immediate alerts for merge conflicts and stale runs
features_wins.body_copy_02:
Precision link redirection:
  Shows level, suite, and failure message drilldowns
  Links point to the PR's exact head commit SHA
  Prevents 404 errors for newly added test folders
